title: Thermal RGB: Version, update check and About
change: Info tab: Version & Update, About, Community & Feedback, System Environment; GitHub update check (task T15)
setup: Setup: the plugin v0.3.1 is installed in CoolerControl 5.0.1 with a valid access token and the PC can reach the internet. The latest published GitHub release is v0.2.1, so the page should say you run a newer build. Commands need sudo. Tests marked optional change something temporarily; read their note first. This session tests only the new Info sections; session 001 (rehearsal) covered the rest of the page.

preflight.title: Source tree is version {{target_version}}
preflight.hint: The tests describe another version than the code in this folder; check the branch or create a new test session.

preflight.title: manifest.toml says {{target_version}}
preflight.hint: Bump the version in manifest.toml and __init__.py together.

preflight.title: Installed plugin is version {{target_version}}
preflight.hint: Install it: sudo bash install.sh && sudo systemctl restart coolercontrold

preflight.title: Installed code is identical to the source tree
preflight.hint: The installed copy is stale or edited. Re-run install.sh and restart coolercontrold.

preflight.title: Installed plugin page is identical to the source tree
preflight.hint: Re-run install.sh; CoolerControl serves the installed page.

preflight.title: Plugin service is active
preflight.hint: Restart CoolerControl: sudo systemctl restart coolercontrold

preflight.title: OpenRGB SDK server is listening on 6742
The running plugin reports version {{target_version}}
preflight.hint: The process still runs older code. Restart it (Save and restart plugin, or restart coolercontrold).

preflight.title: The plugin has run its update check (info)
preflight.hint: The check runs a few seconds after the plugin starts; it fails when GitHub cannot be reached.

tests.title: Installed version
tests.expected: Prints 0.3.1.

tests.title: Update check ran
tests.expected: A line thermal-rgb 0.3.1 starting and a line Update check: ahead (latest v0.2.1). If it says Update check failed, note the reason (no internet?).

sections.title: 1. Version & Update
sections.intro: New card on the Info tab, below Status.

tests.title: Installed version
steps: Open Plugins → thermal-rgb and read the Version & Update card and the header next to the plugin name.
tests.expected: Installed shows v0.3.1; the header also says v0.3.1.

tests.title: Latest release
tests.expected: It says v0.2.1 is the latest published release and you run a newer build, with a Release link. It does not claim an update is available.

tests.title: Release link
tests.expected: The v0.2.1 release page of github.com/droltr/cc-plugin-thermal-rgb opens in a new tab. If CoolerControl blocks it, note that.

tests.title: Last checked
tests.expected: Today's date and a time in your local time zone, a few minutes ago or less.

tests.title: Check again
tests.expected: A note says the plugin is restarting; afterwards Last checked shows a new time, the Status card is Running again, and the LEDs keep working.

sections.title: 2. About
sections.intro: Compare with CoolerDash's About section if you like.

tests.title: About rows
tests.expected: Rows: Plugin Thermal RGB (cc-plugin-thermal-rgb); What it does (blue to red by CPU temperature, never changes fan speeds); Author droltr; Repository github.com/droltr/cc-plugin-thermal-rgb; License GPL-3.0-or-later; Language Python 3.x.y; Credits with the third-party notices link.

tests.title: Author and repository links
tests.expected: The GitHub profile and the repository open in new tabs.

tests.title: Details sections
steps: Open How it works, Tested hardware and Troubleshooting under About.
tests.expected: All three expand and are readable; Tested hardware mentions the MSI B850 board, Ryzen 7 9800X3D and DDR5-6000 modules with ENE controllers.

tests.title: Readability
steps: Look at the whole Info tab in your usual theme.
tests.expected: The new cards match the rest of the page and CoolerControl's theme (spacing, colours, text size). Note anything that looks off or hard to find.

tests.title: Links
steps: Click GitHub Issues, Release notes and downloads, README and Troubleshooting guide.
tests.expected: Each opens the matching page of the repository: the new-issue chooser, the releases list, the README and docs/troubleshooting.md. The troubleshooting guide exists on the main branch after the next release; if it shows a 404, note it.

tests.title: Private security report (optional)
steps: Click Report a vulnerability privately. Do not submit anything.
tests.expected: GitHub's private vulnerability report form opens (you may need to be signed in).

tests.title: Platform, kernel and CoolerControl
steps: Run uname -r and compare with the page.
Compare CoolerControl's version (its About or the Info card header) with the page.
tests.expected: Platform Linux; Kernel equals uname -r; CoolerControl equals 5.0.1 (or the version you run). A dash for the CoolerControl row means the page could not read it; note that.

tests.title: Python and openrgb-python
tests.expected: Python equals the Python row (and the Language row in About); openrgb-python equals 0.3.8.

sections.title: 5. Regression of the rest of the page
sections.intro: These worked in session 001; check they still do.

tests.title: Status and zones
tests.expected: Plugin Running, token Stored, five zones with 8 LEDs each, state in use.

tests.title: Live temperature and LEDs
steps: Watch the temperature and the colour swatch for 10 seconds; look at the LEDs.
tests.expected: The temperature updates, the swatch is blue at idle and the LEDs show the same blue.

tests.title: API Settings still saves
steps: Open API Settings, leave *** in the field and press Save and restart plugin.
tests.expected: Saved message, Info is Running, and the Version & Update card is filled again after the restart.

sections.title: 6. Robustness
sections.intro: Test N2 is optional: it replaces the stored token with an invalid one on purpose. Create a new valid token in CoolerControl first and keep it for N3.

tests.title: Update info survives a CoolerControl restart (optional)
steps: Run sudo systemctl restart coolercontrold, wait 30 seconds and open Info.
tests.expected: Plugin Running; Version & Update shows the latest release again with a new Last checked time.

tests.title: Invalid token keeps the update info (optional)
steps: On API Settings type cc_invalid-test-token and press Save and restart plugin.
tests.expected: Plugin shows Waiting for dependencies with the HTTP 401 hint, and Version & Update still shows the latest release (the update check does not need CoolerControl). Do N3 right away.

tests.title: Valid token again (needed after N2)
steps: Paste the new valid token and press Save and restart plugin.
tests.expected: Plugin Running again, the error is gone, LEDs follow the temperature.
